description: This Java class 'Version2Header' is responsible for generating a header file with version information derived from SVN revision data and git hash. It executes an SVN info command, processes its output to extract version revision, and writes relevant data to 'svnversion.h'.

classes.name: Version2Header
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating version header file from SVN and git info.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments, executes SVN command, parses output, and calls to generate header file.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Private method that creates 'svnversion.h' file with version and git hash information.
